title: Area Between Sine and Cosine Curves
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the area of the region bounded by y = sin(x) and y = cos(x) from x = pi/4 to x = 5*pi/4.

steps.title: Set Up Area Double Integral
steps.mathExpression: \text{Area} = \int_{\pi/4}^{5\pi/4} \int_{\cos x}^{\sin x} 1 \, dy \, dx = \int_{\pi/4}^{5\pi/4} (\sin x - \cos x) \, dx
steps.why: Setting up area between trigonometric curves.

steps.title: Integrate Trigonometric Functions
steps.explanation: Evaluate trigonometric antiderivatives at 5*pi/4 and pi/4.
